title: PIXEL FIGHT
oneLiner: Trade punches, block at the right moment, and land a three-hit combo to win the round!
mechanics: Move a colorful fighter left and right in a single-screen arena; A throws a short-range punch.
Tap B to block briefly, reducing incoming damage; release it to attack again.
The computer rival advances, punches, blocks, and retreats in readable three-step patterns.
Land three distinct hits within 2 seconds for a combo bonus; rounds last up to 30 seconds.
Pressure rises in three bounded phases, with a short recovery pause after each exchange.

controls.a: Punch when close to the rival

lose: Lose the round when your 3-heart meter is emptied; win by emptying the rival's meter first or leading when time expires.
scoring: Score 100 per clean punch and 500 for each completed three-hit combo, capped at a 3x combo multiplier that resets when no hit lands for 2 seconds.
